name: com.geo402/mcp
title: Geo402 Geo Search and Web Fetch
description: Google search and public web pages as seen from another country. Pay per call.

tools.name: fetch_page_from_country
tools.description: Fetch one public web page through a residential IP in the chosen country (optionally a city or US state) and return clean markdown (or text/html), with title, final URL, status, and the product price/currency/availability extracted when present. $0.005 per page (x402, USDC on Base), charged only if the page loads. Public pages only; robots.txt respected; no CAPTCHA solving.

country.description: Country of the residential exit IP, e.g. de, jp, br (default: any)

format.description: markdown (default, best for reading), text, or raw html

city.description: Optional city for the exit IP, needs country (e.g. berlin). +$0.005.

state.description: Optional US state, needs country=us (e.g. texas). +$0.005.

tools.name: render_page_from_country
tools.description: Load one public page in headless Chrome through a residential IP in the chosen country, so JavaScript runs: single-page apps, prices and content filled in by scripts. Returns markdown (or text/html), title, final URL, the extracted product price, and optionally a JPEG screenshot as an image. $0.020 per page, +$0.020 with a screenshot (x402, USDC on Base), charged only if the page loads. Use fetch_page_from_country first for ordinary pages: it's cheaper. Public pages only; robots.txt respected; no CAPTCHA solving.

country.description: Country of the residential exit IP, e.g. de, jp, br (default: any)

format.description: markdown (default, best for reading), text, or raw html

wait_for.description: Optional CSS selector to wait for (up to 10 s), e.g. .price

wait_ms.description: Optional extra wait after the page settles, in ms

city.description: Optional city for the exit IP, needs country. +$0.005.

tools.name: compare_page_across_countries
tools.description: Fetch the same public page from 2-5 countries in one paid call: status, redirect, language, the product price converted to USD, an excerpt (or full content), and the cheapest country. $0.005 per country, one payment; not charged if no country loads.

include_content.description: true = full content per country (default: excerpts)

format.description: markdown (default, best for reading), text, or raw html

tools.name: search_from_country
tools.description: Search Google as a user in the chosen country and language sees it: ranked results, answer box, People Also Ask, related searches; or news, Maps places or images. $0.004 per search, charged only on success.

country.description: Google market to search from, e.g. ca, fr, de, jp (default us)

lang.description: Result language, e.g. fr, en, de, pt-br (default: the market's)

location.description: With type=places: the city, e.g. "Montreal, Quebec, Canada"

tools.name: compare_search_across_countries
tools.description: Run one Google search in 2-5 countries: ranked results per country, sites ranking in several, and (optional) where your domain ranks in each. $0.004 per country, one payment.

domain.description: Optional site to track, e.g. example.com

lang.description: Result language, e.g. fr, en, de, pt-br (default: the market's)

tools.name: search_and_read
tools.description: Search Google from a country, then open the top 1-5 results through residential IPs in that same country and return each page as markdown. $0.004 + $0.005 per page read, one payment; not charged if no page loads.

country.description: Google market to search from, e.g. ca, fr, de, jp (default us)

lang.description: Result language, e.g. fr, en, de, pt-br (default: the market's)

read.description: How many top results to read (default 3)

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Free. Whether a URL is allowed (public page, not a blocked service, allowed by robots.txt) before paying.

country.description: Country of the residential exit IP, e.g. de, jp, br (default: any)

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Free. All 2-letter country codes available for the exit IP.

tools.name: free_sample
tools.description: Free. A real, recent result from a paid tool: fetch (a product page from Germany), compare (one product's price in several countries) or search (a Google search from Canada in French).

tools.name: how_to_pay
tools.description: Free. Prices, network and how paid tools are paid on this hosted MCP server.
